over.heroSubtitle: Get to know the story behind this website
over.heading: About this website and me
over.p1: Hi, I'm Lynn — the person behind this blog. This site combines two of my passions: Crete and technology.
over.p2: My first trip to Crete was in 1998. What started as a family holiday grew into a lasting interest in the island, its people and its history. As a teenager I preferred staying home ("who wants to walk around with their parents in the heat?"), but these days Crete is a place I keep coming back to.
over.p3: The island has everything that fascinates me: from prehistory and classical antiquity to Byzantine influences and stories from the two world wars. Every trip feels like another step in discovering that rich past.
over.p4: Besides my love for Crete, I also have a soft spot for technology. I build and maintain this website myself, learning about web design and graphic design along the way.
over.p5: The photos on this site are partly my own, partly carefully selected to show the atmosphere of the island.
over.p6: I don't write as a guide or an expert, but as someone who is simply moved by Crete — by its history, hospitality, food and the rhythm of life there.
over.p7: Welcome to my blog, where I try to show the real Crete: honest, warm and with a personal touch.

climateBox.heading: Climate in Crete
climateBox.paragraph: Crete enjoys a wonderful Mediterranean climate, with warm, dry summers and mild, pleasant winters. From May to October you can count on reliably sunny weather, clear blue skies and a cooling sea breeze that keeps even hot days comfortable. The summer months are ideal for sun-worshippers and beachgoers, while spring and autumn are perfect for those who want to avoid the crowds — the island turns fresh green, flowers bloom, and temperatures are ideal for walking, cycling or exploring charming villages in peace.

introBox.heading: About
introBox.paragraph: Hi, I'm Lynn 👋 A true philhellene with a soft spot for Crete — the island where sun, sea and simplicity still go hand in hand. Since my first visit I lost my heart to the hospitable people, the wonderful food and the relaxed way of life. On this website I share my passion for Greek life, culture and the small discoveries that make Crete so special. From hidden beaches to local traditions and tips for an authentic travel experience — everything that makes this island so unique, you'll find here.
